justification: The charity is recognised as a charity for tax purposes (E02), the donor has paid £980 in Income Tax for the 2025–26 tax year, which exceeds the total Gift Aid claimed (£80) for that year (E04), the donor has made a signed Gift Aid declaration (E05), the donation was made via direct bank transfer (not Payroll Giving, E09), it was not for goods or services or in exchange for a benefit (E10), and it was not from a charity card or voucher (E13). The evidence does not indicate any benefit over a certain limit (E11) or a payment of shares (E12), and these conditions are not required to be satisfied for a donation to be eligible for Gift Aid. All conditions necessary for Gift Aid eligibility are met based on the provided evidence.
scope_issues: The policy does not specify whether Gift Aid eligibility applies to recurring donations (e.g., monthly direct debits) or only to one-off donations, though it references 'donations' generally.
